# BK Tech Hub

> BK Tech Hub builds BK Chat (AI-powered WhatsApp automation) plus website creation, hosting, and SEO for growing businesses in Nairobi, Kenya.

## Primary product
- BK Chat: WhatsApp AI automation with human takeover, quote generation, calendar booking, and reminders

## Services
- Website creation
- Hosting
- SEO
